basic_info.description: Enjoy Golden Gate Park and Inner Richmond in this spacious, updated duplex blending vintage charm with modern upgrades. Perfectly located, the middle unit and garden level will be delivered vacant while you collect income from the tenant-occupied upper unit. Both main units feature two bedrooms plus a sunroom, split bathrooms, formal dining rooms, and laundry rooms. The middle unit boasts an updated eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and new quartz countertops. The formal dining room with original built-in buffet opens to a living room with a clinker brick fireplace, bench seating, crown moldings, and tray ceilings. Refinished hardwood floors extend from front to back. Two large bedrooms and a sunroom overlook the spacious rear garden. At garden level, a refreshed one-bedroom offers a lovely garden view. Two-car tandem parking and a storage room included. Just 1/2 block to GGP's DeYoung Museum, Academy of Sciences, and Japanese Tea Garden, with nearby playgrounds, courts, and traffic-free areas. Close to Balboa's restaurants, Safeway, and Clement St Farmer's Market, plus easy access to 5 Fulton, 31 Balboa, and 38 Geary bus lines.
